name: sutando
description: Sutando — a personal AI agent with a voice interface and selectable Claude Code or Codex CLI core.

scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:py
scripts.test:py: l=$(mktemp); s=$(mktemp); find tests -name '*.test.py' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' > "$l"; d=$?; if [ "$d" -ne 0 ]; then echo "python: test DISCOVERY exited $d — partial file list, refusing to report a count"; rm -f "$l" "$s"; exit 1; fi; sort "$l" > "$s"; o=$?; if [ "$o" -ne 0 ]; then echo "python: test-list SORT exited $o — partial ordering, refusing to report a count"; rm -f "$l" "$s"; exit 1; fi; { fail=0; n=0; failed=''; t=$(command -v timeout || true); while IFS= read -r f; do n=$((n+1)); echo "--- $f ---"; ${t:+$t -k 10 420} python3 -u "$f" </dev/null || { rc=$?; fail=1; if [ "$rc" -eq 124 ] && [ -n "$t" ]; then failed="$failed $f(TIMEOUT>420s)"; else failed="$failed $f"; fi; }; done; if [ "$n" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'python: 0 test files discovered under tests/ — refusing to report success'; exit 1; fi; if [ "$fail" -eq 0 ]; then echo "python: $n file(s) ran, all passed"; else echo "python: $n file(s) ran, failed:$failed"; fi; exit "$fail"; } < "$s"; rc=$?; rm -f "$l" "$s"; exit "$rc"
